title: coryphantha conoidea
intro: Coryphantha conoidea, commonly known as the Pincushion Cactus, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It is a small, globular cactus with short, fine spines that resemble a pincushion, native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The health benefits of Coryphantha conoidea include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health issues such as wounds, skin conditions, and infections. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
